Namespace: demo_ns
Description: Toy scientific namespace used to demonstrate pipen's agent-facing surface.

Available processes:
  CountReads (proc): Count the reads in a single FASTQ file
  FastqStats (proc): Read-length statistics of a paired-end FASTQ sample

Use get_process('demo_ns', '<process_name>') to see detailed arguments.
